definitions.full: H1050. Beth -rechob בֵּיתרְֿחוֺב proper name, of a location ( place of street , or market ?) near Dan on road to Hamath Judg 18:28 ; 2Sam 10:6 (where בֵּיתרְֿחוֺב אֲרַם ) = רְחֹב Num 13:21 ; compare וּרְחוֺב צוֺבָא אֲרַם 2Sam 10:8 ; — location dubious (compare Rob iii. 371 f. ).

occurrences.englishText: There was no deliverer, because it was far from Sidon, and they had no dealings with anyone else; and it was in the valley that lies by Beth Rehob. They built the city and lived in it.

When the children of Ammon saw that they had become odious to David, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Beth Rehob, and the Syrians of Zobah, twenty thousand footmen, and the king of Maacah with one thousand men, and the men of Tob twelve thousand men.
